title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the beverage cooling data. Fitted multiple models including Newton's Law of Cooling, Double Exponential, and Stretched Exponential. The Double Exponential model provided the best fit, accounting for multiple heat transfer mechanisms. Generated comparison and residual plots, and compiled the findings into a comprehensive report in report/report.md.
